data.statement: Correction: the first sample labeled as the Middle Management 24-hour checkpoint was 20.927 seconds early; the 23:53:28.971Z sample supersedes it and confirms the same zero-distribution result after the exact boundary.
data.decision: Use only the confirmed after-threshold event for the 24-hour gate, keep the candidate measuring, and preserve the seven-day cohort comparison gate.
data.nextAction: Recheck at seven days and compare Arm A only after the cohort has meaningful public impressions.
